list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Critical / Correctness #1 — IPv6 firewall blocking on Linux (guard_linux.go, common.go) The guard now enforces both families: a linuxFamily table drives parallel inet/inet6 ipsets (almighty_block_ips6, almighty_block_tor_ips6) with iptables and ip6tables rules. Added a shared splitIPsByFamily helper and refactored apply/check into applySet + ensureRejectRule. Previously IPv6 Tor/manual IPs were fetched but silently failed to enter the IPv4-only ipset.
#2 — Duplicate firewall enforcer (main.go) The torfetch callback now drives the single continuous fwGuard (via its serialized reconcile mutex) instead of a second fwApply instance writing the same rule names. fwApply remains only as the synchronous startup one-shot (needed for the apply-once semantics in noprotection builds), so there are no longer two concurrent writers.
Suggestions #3 / #5 — Dead code — Deleted the entire unused internal/dnsengine package (which also eliminates the plaintext 1.1.1.1:53 bootstrap resolver from #5), plus the uncalled, untested runtime hosts functions HostsPath/EnforceHostsLoop/enforceHosts in redirects.go and their now-unused imports.
#4 — README (README.md) — Corrected the claims that the hosts file is enforced between markers, that the blocklist is "consumed via redirects.ParseLines at runtime," and that markers live in main.go. Now describes the DNS+firewall reality and the embedded blocklist as inert/reserved. Also fixed the stale "domains via resolved IPs" firewall line.
#6 — Atomic heartbeat write (watchdog.go) — writeOwnState now writes a temp file and os.Renames it over the target, so the partner role can't read a torn JSON heartbeat and trigger a spurious restart.
#7 — Locale-independent interfaces (hijack_windows.go) — activeInterfaceNames now uses net.Interfaces() (FlagUp + non-loopback) instead of matching the English words "Enabled"/"Connected" in netsh output, which returned nothing on localized Windows.
#8 — Logging symmetry (logging_unprotected.go) — Created the file that logging_protected.go referenced; the noprotection build now explicitly keeps the stderr logger.
